messages:
Ravi: spotted a confusing thing on dashboard: p50/p95 labels have a tooltip that says 'computed from merged samples' but users keep asking why p95< p50 in some slices. any quick wins?
Hannah: likely mixed provenance + tdigest merge artifacts. but UX can help reduce confusion. people expect monotonic ordering.
Diego: agree. small product suggestions: 1) if merged samples produce an inversion show a tiny warning icon next to percentiles: 'merged provenance may invert percentiles; enable provenance to inspect origins' 2) add an explainer flyout that shows per-origin percentiles when requested
Ravi: sounds good. ops asked for a low-effort fix today: detect inversion in UI and show a non-blocking banner that links to the flyout. longer term we fix merge weights backend.
Diego: backend plan is in progress: patch tdigest weight normalization + include sample_count and origins in rollup response. ETA 48h. will also add provenance query param for console to request full-origin rollups.
Hannah: for the flyout design: small modal anchored to percentile tile showing table: origin | sample_count | p50 | p95. default request does not fetch per-origin data; toggling 'Show origins' calls rollup?provenance=origins. keep performance conservative.
Ravi: ops wants the banner text to be actionable: 'Percentiles may be unstable for this micro-slice due to mixed sample sources. Click to inspect origins.' and a link to runbook article.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-3212 for the UI banner + flyout work.
Diego: PR #1405 opened for rollup schema + tdigest fixes. added tests for inversion scenarios.
deploy-bot: deploy 6136201150 to staging scheduled by @release-scheduler
Ravi: will validate on staging once deploy is up and confirm banner appears for inversion samples.
Hannah: I'll draft the flyout copy and small icon states. will drop designs in the thread.
Ravi: thanks all. small UX patch should reduce support noise until backend merge finishes.
